experiment: Active: 2026-05-09-multi-source-floor-3 (politics/economy multi-source floor 2→3 in select-prompt.md). evaluateAfter 2026-05-16 — not yet ready. Today's multiSource=7 on partial-day output is encouraging vs ~21–22% weekly baseline. The expired noNewExperimentsUntil:2026-05-12 gate has been dropped. No new experiment proposed — all daily-audit metrics within targets and one active experiment is occupying the sourcing-cluster dimension.
weakestArea: AF/OC representation: 1 article each today, against an ME-heavy distribution (11/30 = 37%). Regions target (≥4 unique) is comfortably met, but AF coverage has been thin two days running (6 yesterday → 1 today). Likely a feed-side cluster gap rather than a selector flaw — worth watching, not yet actionable.
watching: Multi-source floor experiment: 4 cycles in, partial-day multiSource=7/30 (~23%) tracks toward the +28% target.
ME concentration (11/30 today): Israel/Gaza and Egypt/Mada Masr stories driving the share — natural if the news week stays Levant-heavy, but check Friday's snapshot for AF rebalance.
Briefing/audio pipeline: 04:00 and 16:00 cycles ran clean; no audio-stage errors flagged in metrics.
coverageGaps: Africa: 1 article today (Daily Maverick) — Sub-Saharan economic and political stories under-represented vs feed availability.
Oceania: 1 article today — typical baseline, but a New Zealand or Pacific island lens absent across this week.
Latin America: AM bucket today (6) is North-America-skewed; check whether Bloomberg/Yahoo dominance is crowding LatAm regional outlets.
context: Day 4 of the multi-source floor experiment (2→3 on politics+economy). The post-2026-05-02 model lineup (Opus 4.7 high on reflect, Opus medium on tune, editorial-memo consumed at every cycle) is now stable and the noNewExperimentsUntil gate has lapsed as expected. With one active experiment still occupying the sourcing-cluster dimension and three days until its evaluation window, the prudent call is to hold and let it settle — proposing an orthogonal experiment now would only be justified by a metric breach, which today's data does not show.
